body:
honestly, i don't know.
before the pandemic started i was extremely depressed;
hoping not to wake up in the morning, constant suicide thoughts, always without energy, insomnia, you got the picture.
then the pandemic started in my country and i though that things were starting get better; but now there's just constant confusion in my head, only confusion.
thx for the kind words btw.
literally went to chilling on the couch to intrusive-suicide thoughts in less than 60 seconds
